Faroe Petroleum plc, an independent gas and oil company, engages in the exploration, appraisal, development, and production of gas and oil fields in Northwest Europe. The company has market cap of 541.67 million GBP. It has interests in the Schooner and Ketch gas fields, and the Blane oil field in the United Kingdom; and the Brage, Ringhorne East, Ula, Tambar, Oselvar, and Trym fields in Norway. It currently has negative earnings. As of January 1, 2017, it had proven and probable reserves of 81.3 million barrels of oil equivalent.
